Please share your alternatives to InstantPot!
I’ve been thinking about getting an instant pot lately but found out they sold to private equity a few years back. Considering that’s always a death sentence for quality and in my research I’ve seen more than enough horror stories about the instant pot customer service, I’ve opted to avoid them now. Unfortunately, I’m not familiar with any of the competitors out there. Does anyone have any alternative companies they swear by?
